scope: All 64 OSF-* neutral seafloor features accounted for: every structure-template-feasible ID implemented (44 of 64, all in this catalog); the remaining 20 IDs are either terrain-scale landforms (OSF-002,003,004,009,011,012,024,025,026,028,030,043 -- 9,011,012,024,028 are catalogued here as "specified" pending a density-function path, the other 7 have no catalog record yet) or ambient placed-feature microtexture (OSF-057-064, tracked in the pool doc only). All require a density-function/placed-feature authoring path distinct from this catalog's structure_template pipeline.
